core_meaning.primary_meaning: Zubair is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Strong, firm”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Zubair corresponds to the Arabic form زُبَيْر (Arabic root ز ب ر (z-b-r); زُبَيْر (Zubayr)). Its core sense is zubair; strong, firm. Zubair is Arabic زُبَيْر (Zubayr), a diminutive associated with the sense 'strong, firm'. It was borne by a companion of the Prophet.

persian.name: زبیر
persian.long_meaning: Zubair (زبیر) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن زبیر، نیرومند است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

arabic.name: زُبَيْر
